Coder (pij-back-tapir), 2026-11-06: s07, s06 and s09 as built, and where the PRs stand.

## s07 role memory and the memory turn (plan 201, #132, merged 9527d9e)
- Notes: community/memory.rs. One pij/memory ddoc per note, roles/<role>/memory/<date>-<slug>.dd.json; INDEX.md regenerated inside a fenced <!-- pij:generated --> block; Markdown escaped; nothing deleted.
- Turn: http/memory_turn.rs. Every compact or close of a role holder answers held at once (a valid Receipt for compact) and runs in the background. Bound 5 min (memory_turn::BOUND, PIJ_RS_MEMORY_TURN_SECS clamps at 300 s) from hold time, admission included (F005). One pending turn per seat (E-RS-MEMORY-TURN-PENDING). Brakes before acting: tombstoned, incarnation (proc/pane) changed, or a close whose actor lost authority. memory.turn spine event records action, holdings, ended, waited_ms, bound_ms, then.
- Open follow-up (pm-001, not built): if a reviewer blocks on a late-landing prompt, await the owned admission after the action and record admission delivered-late|queued|refused.

## s06 outputs and notification (plan 200, #137 draft, head 4ab6460)
- Migration 0036 community_outputs; pij output <kind> --role --subject [--head --result --answers]; pij outputs --subject --head | --role. --answers marks the request answered (kestrel's mark_role_request_answered, idempotent) and tells the requester in its reply mode; block/failed always wake; unrequested goes FYI to the parent, else the prime.
- AC5 cost: one writer commit per output (git 7, ddocs 2); notify is one delivery; reads launch nothing.
- Next push (when #129 and #133 merge): merge #133's head 9919d4d (not 72f6d98) and main, amend 4ab6460 with trailers, retarget to main, force-push once. Delivers line already set (s06, req-08, req-10).

## Habits that paid off
- Merges of sibling plan branches conflict at the same seams (endpoint ALL count, CLI Command enum, routing.ts, docs changelog rows). Resolve as unions; rerun rustfmt --check to catch a misplaced brace.
- Stopping just shared-build can orphan cargo and leave <target>.lock stale: kill the orphan, rm the lock.
- At load above ~30, push and let CI prove it; junit-linux has every test name.
